project.name: NextPhaze Athletic Training
project.status: implementation brief complete with visible launch blockers
preparedFrom: the complete source DOCX, including tables
public-source verification and category research performed 2026-08-30

business.offer: Focused athletic development for speed, footwork, agility, movement quality, position-specific skill, discipline, confidence, and conditioning.

availability.mondayFriday: Flexible / open availability, subject to confirmed bookings

business.cancellation: Bookings may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled session.

audiences.primary: Parents and guardians evaluating coaching credibility, fit, cost, safety, logistics, and booking ease.
audiences.secondary: Athletes who need the brand to feel competitive, legitimate, aspirational, and relevant to progression.

positioning.statement: NextPhaze Athletic Training develops athletes through focused speed, movement, discipline, position-specific skill work, and competitive preparation, led by former Western Michigan #15 Carrington Thompson, a MAC Champion and professional indoor football champion.
positioning.campaignMessage: Your current level is not your final level.
positioning.brandIdea: Development happens one phase at a time.
positioning.proofRole: Carrington's career supports the training offer; it does not replace the training offer.

verifiedProof: 2016 MAC Champion and Cotton Bowl team member
50 receptions, 726 yards, and 8 touchdowns at Western Michigan

brand.media: Authentic client-supplied Carrington imagery is the visual anchor.

technical.startingState: The repository contained an Astro implementation plus an obsolete, independently maintained static HTML copy.
technical.chosenStack: Astro static output with content collections, CloudCannon editing, shared CSS, and minimal progressive-enhancement JavaScript.
technical.why: Astro provides one content-driven source of truth while preserving static performance, CloudCannon editability, and an explicit external booking integration boundary.

assumptions: The supplied image files may be used for this build because the client placed them in the project; ownership/production rights still require confirmation before launch.
Carrington Thompson is the preferred display name until the client confirms whether to use 'Sr.'.
The site may present a booking-request interface and honest email/phone fallback, but may not claim live scheduling, payment, notifications, or calendar sync until a provider and credentials exist.
The proposed six-route architecture is approved for implementation under the prompt's autonomous-run clause, not by the client.
launchBlockers: Training location, service city/radius, venue type, parking, and access instructions
Athlete age range and parent-on-site requirements
Cancellation/reschedule/no-show/refund/weather/late-arrival details beyond the verified 12-hour cancellation window
Payment processor, fees/taxes, and online-payment credentials
Waiver/release and privacy language supplied or approved by counsel
Media ownership/permissions and original high-resolution files
Any credentials, certifications, coaching affiliations, testimonials, or athlete outcomes intended for publication
